title: Chromuta palette mapping
description: Maps colors found in a codebase to their replacements.

defaultNotation.description: Notation every replacement is written in. Without it, each replacement keeps the notation its own "to" value was authored in.

tolerance.description: Perceptual distance in OKLab within which a color still matches a rule. 0 means exact matches only; about 0.02 is a just-noticeable difference.

exclude.description: Globs for files the mapping skips, such as snapshots and test fixtures.

rules.description: Colors to replace. An exact match always wins over a match within tolerance.

from.description: Color to look for, in any notation Chromuta reads.

to.description: Color to write instead, in any notation Chromuta reads.

tolerance.description: Overrides the mapping-level tolerance for this rule.
